hooks.text: 高速FPV飞行要求穿越障碍、串联精准攻击航线，并从非常规角度打击目标。
hooks.excerpt: Dive through obstacles, chain perfect attack runs, and strike from impossible angles. Go loud with guns blazing or strike with surgical precision.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从基础机架开始混装武器，在高速截击机与重型炮艇等方向间打造专属无人机。
hooks.excerpt: Your drone is your canvas. Start with basic frames and build a deadly arsenal of war machines. Mix weapons, discover deadly combinations, and tune your builds between missions. From swift interceptors to heavy gunships, craft the perfect killing machine.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战利品会永久扩建基地、解锁新无人机并研发高级武器，让每次坠毁后仍持续成长。
hooks.excerpt: Turn combat spoils into lasting power. Expand your base, unlock new drones, and develop advanced weapons. Every run makes you stronger - your skills sharpen with each flight, and your base grows with every piece of salvage.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
